verdict.rationale: Pulumi is CLI-driven and offers the Automation API, which runs the Pulumi engine as an SDK without the CLI. That lets infrastructure create/update/destroy operations be embedded in automated software. It also has GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps integrations with PR comments and checks, plus self-managed state backends suited to unattended runs. Community feedback praises the Automation feature. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline docs (e.g. a GitHub Actions setup), documented non-interactive/headless flags, and token-based auth guidance for CI runners.
